formula.availability: At decision date t, use sleeve returns only through row t-1 because row t realizes t-to-t+1.
formula.rebalance: Recompute cross-sleeve scores at month-end decision rows and hold the score multiplier until the next month-end.
formula.momentum: Compounded trailing sleeve return, cross-sectionally z-scored and clipped to [-2,2].
formula.sharpe: Trailing arithmetic mean divided by sample volatility, cross-sectionally z-scored and clipped to [-2,2].
formula.inverse_vol: Negative trailing volatility, cross-sectionally z-scored and clipped to [-2,2].
formula.tilt: Multiply frozen causal GGG sleeve weights by exp(weighted score), then renormalize to the unchanged risky-sleeve budget.
formula.lookthrough: Use frozen sleeve holdings, retain GGG state-conditional offense projection, preserve cash, and reapply the 35% ETF cap.

decision_rule: Passing candidates enter a research-only locked-forward shortlist. No production promotion from already-observed data.
scope_limits: Exactly six formulas are tested; no strengths or lookbacks are optimized after seeing results.
The evaluation windows are already observed and therefore are not untouched evidence.
No live trading or capital deployment.
